_comment: Single source of truth for the ByteReport design language, shared with the ByteForge portfolio: a dark navy ground and one cyan accent. Read by the web app (src/index.css mirrors these, a test pins every value; src/lib/chartTokens.ts and motionTokens.ts import them) and by the PDF/Excel pipeline (app/services/design_tokens.py). Change a value here and both surfaces follow.

theme._comment: The web, on a dark ground. accent_ink is the text on an accent fill (the primary button). Borders are translucent so they sit the same on the ground and on a card.

charts._comment: Web charts, and the PDF charts for everything except the main series and negatives (see pdf). Main series = the accent, second = blue, negative = coral. `categories` is hue-varied (no violet); the last slot is the neutral reserved for 'Other'. Colours are assigned by category NAME (see assign_category_colors), not by sort position, so a category keeps its colour between reports.

severity._comment: Risk levels on the web. The base hue draws hairlines and low-alpha tints; *_fg is the same level as text on the dark ground. Print versions live under pdf.severity.

zones._comment: Health Score zones on the web, critical -> excellent: coral, amber, green, cyan. Read by scoreColor() and mirrored in index.css (success / warning / danger). Print versions live under pdf.zones.

pdf._comment: Everything that lands on white paper: the PDF report and the Excel export. The web accent #3DE6D6 is near-invisible on white, so each colour here is a darker relative of its web token that clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) against white as text - and white text on it, for table headers. A test pins the contrast.

motion._comment: Motion on the web (Motion library + CSS). One curve, ease-out with no overshoot: every y in [0,1]. Hover/press 150-250 ms, blocks appear in 400-700 ms. Under prefers-reduced-motion only fades remain (MotionConfig reducedMotion='user') and count-ups show the final value at once.

effects._comment: Background and highlight effects. The hero glows are the accent and the chart blue at 11% opacity, as in the ByteForge hero; the grid is primary text at 4%. selection is highlighted text.
